findings.title: Fallback locales are loaded only during controller requests
findings.body: The translation accelerator loads only the active locale when `I18n.t` is called; this callback is the only new code that loads the fallback locales. Calls from Sidekiq jobs, rake tasks, or other code outside a controller request therefore try fallback lookups without having loaded those locale files, so translations that should fall back can still be missing. Load the fallback chain as part of translation lookup or initialize it for non-request processes too.

findings.title: Changing the site locale can leave cached translations stale
findings.body: This fallback chain depends on the mutable `SiteSetting.default_locale`, but the translation accelerator caches results by translation key, active locale, and backend—not by the fallback chain. For a logged-in user whose locale is unchanged, changing the site default can leave translations cached from the old fallback locale, so they continue seeing the old text until the cache is cleared. Include the fallback configuration in cache invalidation or otherwise invalidate translations when the setting changes.
